name: Volumetric Silhouette Rendering
definition: A technique to render silhouettes of volumetric data by detecting edges where the view vector is perpendicular to the surface normal, using a 3D normal map and a pre-computed cube map for view vector normalization.
summary: Volumetric Silhouette Rendering detects silhouette edges in volumetric data by rasterizing pre-computed normal fields, distinguishing itself from geometry-based methods by operating directly on volume representations.
